howItWorks.headline: Three steps between ownership and income.

steps.title: Tell Us About Your Property
steps.body: A short conversation about your home, its location, condition and what you want it to achieve. No obligation, no pressure.

steps.title: We Build Your Management Strategy
steps.body: Our team prepares a tailored plan: positioning, income projection, legal structure, maintenance standards and reporting cadence.

steps.title: Enjoy Passive Income
steps.body: We take over completely. You receive reliable income, quarterly asset reviews and full transparency—without a single tenant call.

page.headline: Ownership, without the weight of ownership.
page.body: Six commitments that turn a property into a performing asset—and ask nothing of your time.

features.title: Guaranteed Income
features.body: A clear income structure, paid on schedule. No chasing tenants, no uncertain months.

features.title: Professional Management

features.title: Asset Protection
features.body: Quarterly condition reviews and preventive care, so value compounds instead of eroding.

features.title: Legal Security
features.body: Compliant contracts, verified identities and proper documentation on every agreement.

features.title: Transparent Reporting

features.title: Long-Term Partnership

cta.headline: Your Property Should Work For You.

page.headline: One fee. Nothing behind it.
page.body: We earn only when your asset earns. A single management fee covers the entire operation—everything else is passed through at cost, with the paperwork attached.

feeCard.description: of the income your property generates. Charged monthly, deducted from your statement, never invoiced separately.
feeCard.footnote: No onboarding fee. No listing fee. No renewal fee.

included.footnote: Third-party costs such as repairs or utilities are passed through at cost, with the invoice attached to your statement.

calculator.headline: Calculate Your Rental Income Over Time
calculator.body: See how your passive income compounds with scheduled 10% annual rent appreciation and Agarli's reduced 5% management rate from Year 2 onwards.

items.question: How is the management fee calculated?
items.answer: It is a single percentage of the income your property generates. If the property earns nothing in a given month, the fee is nothing—our incentives stay aligned with yours.

items.question: Are there hidden costs?
items.answer: No. Third-party costs such as repairs or utilities are passed through at cost with the invoice attached to your monthly statement. We add no margin on them.

items.question: Is there a minimum contract term?
items.answer: Our standard agreement runs twelve months so that a strategy has room to work, with a straightforward exit if expectations are not met.

items.question: Can I still use my property?
items.answer: Yes. Owner stays are scheduled in advance and coordinated by your manager, with the property prepared to the same standard we give occupants.

page.headline: Experienced Leadership Behind Agarli.
page.body: Over four decades of combined executive leadership in operations, corporate finance, and governance—delivering institutional standards to residential asset management.

items.bio: A results-driven and operations leader with 20 years of experience across fields. He brings strong capabilities in P&L ownership, operational excellence, and stakeholder management, with a proven ability to lead diverse teams and deliver complex projects in challenging environments. Known for his disciplined execution, customer-centric mindset, and high accountability, Khaled consistently drives sustainable performance and long-term value.

items.name: Joe Mounir
items.bio: Finance and operations leader with over 20 years of experience across regional and multinational roles. He has held senior leadership positions spanning finance, compliance, known for driving performance, leading cross-functional teams to deliver measurable results, With a strong foundation in finance and certifications in IFRS and Lean Six Sigma, he combines strategic insight with hands-on leadership, high ownership, and a people-first mindset.

cards.title: Owner-First Stewardship
cards.body: We manage every residence with the same discipline, accountability, and fiduciary care we would demand for our personal equity.

cards.title: Uncompromising Accountability
